```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(ranger)
library(forecast)
library(data.table)

set.seed(123)
```


This section constructs the national daily COVID-19 modelling data set from the RKI data and the additional covariates.

```{r variable-construction-parameters, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)

start_date <- as.Date("2020-04-01")
end_date   <- as.Date("2026-03-31")
max_ar_p   <- 10

# ============================================================
```

## 1. Load RKI COVID data

```{r vc-1-load-rki-covid-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Load RKI COVID data

url <- "https://zenodo.org/records/20791426/files/Aktuell_Deutschland_SarsCov2_Infektionen.csv?download=1"

download.file(
  url,
  destfile = "rki_covid.csv",
  mode = "wb",
  method = "wininet"
)

covid_file <- read_csv("rki_covid.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

covid <- covid_file %>%
  mutate(
    Meldedatum = as.Date(substr(Meldedatum, 1, 10)),
    Refdatum   = as.Date(substr(Refdatum, 1, 10)),
    AnzahlFall = as.numeric(AnzahlFall),
    IstErkrankungsbeginn = as.numeric(IstErkrankungsbeginn)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Meldedatum >= start_date,
    Meldedatum <= end_date
  )

all_dates <- tibble(
  Meldedatum = seq(start_date, end_date, by = "day")
)

```

## 2. Daily cases

```{r vc-2-daily-cases, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 2. Daily cases

daily_cases <- covid %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum) %>%
  summarise(
    cases = sum(AnzahlFall, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(all_dates, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    cases = replace_na(cases, 0),
    log_cases = log(cases + 1)
  )

```

## 3. Reporting delay covariate

```{r vc-3-reporting-delay-covariate, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 3. Reporting delay covariate
# Reporting-delay limits used in Project 2 Appendix B
minimum_reporting_delay <- -30
maximum_reporting_delay <- 60

reporting_delay_daily <- covid %>%
  # Use only records for which Refdatum is the actual symptom-onset date.
  filter(IstErkrankungsbeginn == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    reporting_delay_raw = as.numeric(Meldedatum - Refdatum),
    reporting_delay_clipped = pmin(
      pmax(reporting_delay_raw, minimum_reporting_delay),
      maximum_reporting_delay
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum) %>%
  summarise(
    reporting_delay_avg = if_else(
      any(!is.na(reporting_delay_clipped)),
      mean(reporting_delay_clipped, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(all_dates, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum)

```

## 4. Symptom onset share covariate

```{r vc-4-symptom-onset-share-covariate, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 4. Symptom-onset share covariate
# Construction follows the professor's recommendation.
# Both the numerator and denominator are restricted to genuinely new cases
# identified by NeuerFall == 1.

symptom_onset_daily <- covid %>%
  mutate(
    known_onset = as.integer(IstErkrankungsbeginn == 1),
    is_new_case = as.integer(NeuerFall == 1),

    # Denominator: genuinely new cases reported on day t.
    new_case_count = if_else(
      is_new_case == 1,
      AnzahlFall,
      0
    ),

    # Numerator: genuinely new cases with a known symptom-onset date.
    new_onset_case_count = if_else(
      is_new_case == 1 & known_onset == 1,
      AnzahlFall,
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum) %>%
  summarise(
    symptom_onset_cases = sum(new_onset_case_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_new_cases = sum(new_case_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    symptom_onset_share = if_else(
      total_new_cases > 0,
      symptom_onset_cases / total_new_cases,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  right_join(all_dates, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum)


```

## 5. Age-share covariates

```{r vc-5-age-share-covariates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 5. Age-share covariates

age_daily <- covid %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum, Altersgruppe) %>%
  summarise(
    age_cases = sum(AnzahlFall, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    total_age_cases = sum(age_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_share = if_else(total_age_cases > 0, age_cases / total_age_cases, 0),
    age_name = paste0("AgeShare_", make.names(as.character(Altersgruppe)))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Meldedatum, age_name, age_share) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = age_name,
    values_from = age_share,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  right_join(all_dates, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("AgeShare_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  )

```

## 6. Gender-share covariates

```{r vc-6-gender-share-covariates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 6. Gender-share covariates

gender_daily <- covid %>%
  mutate(
    gender_value = as.character(Geschlecht)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum, gender_value) %>%
  summarise(
    gender_cases = sum(AnzahlFall, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    total_gender_cases = sum(gender_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    gender_share = if_else(total_gender_cases > 0, gender_cases / total_gender_cases, 0),
    gender_name = paste0("GenderShare_", make.names(gender_value))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Meldedatum, gender_name, gender_share) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender_name,
    values_from = gender_share,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  right_join(all_dates, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("GenderShare_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  )


```

## 7. Temperature covariate from DWD daily climate data

```{r vc-7-temperature-covariate-from-dwd-daily-cli, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 7. Temperature covariate from DWD daily climate data
# DWD KL variable: TMK = daily mean temperature

temp_url_hist   <- "https://opendata.dwd.de/climate_environment/CDC/observations_germany/climate/daily/kl/historical/"
temp_url_recent <- "https://opendata.dwd.de/climate_environment/CDC/observations_germany/climate/daily/kl/recent/"

covid_start <- min(covid$Meldedatum, na.rm = TRUE)
covid_end   <- max(covid$Meldedatum, na.rm = TRUE)

# Get valid RKI Landkreis IDs
valid_landkreis_ids <- unique(as.integer(covid$IdLandkreis))
valid_landkreis_ids <- valid_landkreis_ids[!is.na(valid_landkreis_ids)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Historical DWD ZIP file list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

zip_links_hist <- readLines(temp_url_hist, warn = FALSE)

zip_files_hist <- stringr::str_extract(
  zip_links_hist,
  "tageswerte_KL_[0-9]{5}_[0-9]{8}_[0-9]{8}_hist\\.zip"
)

zip_files_hist <- unique(na.omit(zip_files_hist))

zip_dt_hist <- data.table::data.table(
  zip_file = zip_files_hist
)

zip_dt_hist[, source := "historical"]
zip_dt_hist[, base_url := temp_url_hist]

zip_dt_hist[, STATIONS_ID := as.integer(
  stringr::str_extract(zip_file, "(?<=tageswerte_KL_)\\d{5}")
)]

zip_dt_hist[, start_date_dwd := as.Date(
  stringr::str_match(zip_file, "tageswerte_KL_[0-9]{5}_([0-9]{8})_")[, 2],
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)]

zip_dt_hist[, end_date_dwd := as.Date(
  stringr::str_match(zip_file, "_([0-9]{8})_hist\\.zip$")[, 2],
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)]

zip_dt_hist <- zip_dt_hist[
  start_date_dwd <= covid_end & end_date_dwd >= covid_start
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Recent DWD ZIP file list
# ------------------------------------------------------------

zip_links_recent <- readLines(temp_url_recent, warn = FALSE)

zip_files_recent <- stringr::str_extract(
  zip_links_recent,
  "tageswerte_KL_[0-9]{5}_akt\\.zip"
)

zip_files_recent <- unique(na.omit(zip_files_recent))

zip_dt_recent <- data.table::data.table(
  zip_file = zip_files_recent
)

zip_dt_recent[, source := "recent"]
zip_dt_recent[, base_url := temp_url_recent]

zip_dt_recent[, STATIONS_ID := as.integer(
  stringr::str_extract(zip_file, "(?<=tageswerte_KL_)\\d{5}")
)]

zip_dt_recent[, start_date_dwd := as.Date(NA)]
zip_dt_recent[, end_date_dwd := as.Date(NA)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine historical and recent files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

zip_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(
  list(zip_dt_hist, zip_dt_recent),
  fill = TRUE
)

# Keep only DWD station IDs that directly match RKI Landkreis IDs
zip_dt <- zip_dt[
  STATIONS_ID %in% valid_landkreis_ids
]

if (nrow(zip_dt) == 0) {
  stop("No DWD STATIONS_ID matched RKI IdLandkreis.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Download and extract DWD temperature files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

temp_list <- vector("list", nrow(zip_dt))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(zip_dt))) {

  zip_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".zip")
  extract_dir <- tempfile(pattern = "dwd_")
  dir.create(extract_dir)

  one_temp <- tryCatch({

    download.file(
      url = paste0(zip_dt$base_url[i], zip_dt$zip_file[i]),
      destfile = zip_path,
      mode = "wb",
      quiet = TRUE
    )

    files_inside <- unzip(zip_path, list = TRUE)$Name

    product_file <- files_inside[
      grepl("^produkt_klima_tag_.*\\.txt$", files_inside)
    ][1]

    if (is.na(product_file)) {
      NULL
    } else {

      extracted_file <- unzip(
        zipfile = zip_path,
        files = product_file,
        exdir = extract_dir,
        overwrite = TRUE
      )

      temp_raw <- data.table::fread(
        extracted_file,
        sep = ";",
        na.strings = c("-999", "-999.0"),
        showProgress = FALSE
      )

      temp_raw[, .(
        STATIONS_ID = as.integer(STATIONS_ID),
        Meldedatum = as.Date(as.character(MESS_DATUM), format = "%Y%m%d"),
        temperature = as.numeric(TMK)
      )]
    }

  }, error = function(e) {
    NULL
  })

  temp_list[[i]] <- one_temp

  unlink(zip_path, force = TRUE)
  unlink(extract_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine, clean duplicates, and compute Germany-level temperature
# ------------------------------------------------------------

temp_all <- data.table::rbindlist(
  temp_list,
  fill = TRUE
)

temp_all <- temp_all[
  Meldedatum >= covid_start & Meldedatum <= covid_end
]

temp_all_clean <- temp_all[
  ,
  .(
    temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(STATIONS_ID, Meldedatum)
]

temp_all_clean <- temp_all_clean[
  STATIONS_ID %in% valid_landkreis_ids
]

temp_germany <- temp_all_clean[
  ,
  .(
    temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    districts_used = uniqueN(STATIONS_ID)
  ),
  by = Meldedatum
]

temp_germany[, Meldedatum := as.Date(Meldedatum)]

temperature_daily <- as.data.frame(temp_germany) %>%
  mutate(
    Meldedatum = as.Date(Meldedatum),
    Temp = as.numeric(temperature),
    districts_used = as.integer(districts_used)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Meldedatum,
    Temp,
    districts_used
  ) %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum)

# Fill missing days
temperature_daily <- all_dates %>%
  left_join(temperature_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    Temp = zoo::na.approx(Temp, na.rm = FALSE),
    Temp = zoo::na.locf(Temp, na.rm = FALSE),
    Temp = zoo::na.locf(Temp, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE),
    districts_used = replace_na(districts_used, 0L)
  )

temperature_summary <- temperature_daily %>%
  summarise(
    Start_date = min(Meldedatum, na.rm = TRUE),
    End_date = max(Meldedatum, na.rm = TRUE),
    Observations = n(),
    Missing_Temp = sum(is.na(Temp)),
    Mean_Temp = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Temp = min(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Temp = max(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_districts_used = min(districts_used, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_districts_used = mean(districts_used, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_districts_used = max(districts_used, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

temperature_summary

```

```{r vc-8-weekday-and-public-holiday-variables, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
calendar_daily <- all_dates %>%
  mutate(
    Weekday = factor(
      lubridate::wday(Meldedatum, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
      levels = c("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun")
    ),
    StartOfWeek = if_else(Weekday == "Mon", 1, 0),
    public_holiday = if_else(Meldedatum %in% holiday_dates, 1, 0)
  )

```

## 9. Merge all covariates

```{r vc-9-merge-all-covariates, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 9. Merge all covariates

model_base <- daily_cases %>%
  left_join(age_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  left_join(gender_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  left_join(reporting_delay_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  left_join(symptom_onset_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  left_join(temperature_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  left_join(calendar_daily, by = "Meldedatum") %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    across(starts_with("AgeShare_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    across(starts_with("GenderShare_"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0)),
    reporting_delay_avg = replace_na(reporting_delay_avg, 0),
    symptom_onset_cases = replace_na(symptom_onset_cases, 0),
    symptom_onset_share = replace_na(symptom_onset_share, 0),
    Temp = zoo::na.approx(Temp, na.rm = FALSE),
    Temp = zoo::na.locf(Temp, na.rm = FALSE),
    Temp = zoo::na.locf(Temp, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE),
    districts_used = replace_na(districts_used, 0L),
    StartOfWeek = replace_na(StartOfWeek, 0),
    public_holiday = replace_na(public_holiday, 0)
  )

```
# Create lagged data

```{r create-lagged-data}
model_data <- model_base %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Lagged cases: lag 1 to lag 7
# ------------------------------------------------------------
max_lag <- 10.

for (l in 1:max_lag) {
  model_data[[paste0("lag", l)]] <- dplyr::lag(model_data$log_cases, l)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Identify age and gender variables
# ------------------------------------------------------------
age_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^AgeShare_", names(model_data))]
gender_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^GenderShare_", names(model_data))]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create lag 7 for all covariates
# ------------------------------------------------------------
covariates_to_lag7 <- c(
  "Temp",
  "StartOfWeek",
  "public_holiday",
  "reporting_delay_avg",
  "symptom_onset_share",
  age_vars,
  gender_vars
)

covariates_to_lag7 <- covariates_to_lag7[
  covariates_to_lag7 %in% names(model_data)
]

for (v in covariates_to_lag7) {
  model_data[[paste0(v, "_lag7")]] <- dplyr::lag(model_data[[v]], 7)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Remove rows lost due to lags
# ------------------------------------------------------------
model_data <- model_data %>%
  tidyr::drop_na()


```
#Validation check for lags used for covariates 

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define lag structures to be valiMeldedatumd
# ------------------------------------------------------------

lag_validation_specs <- list(
  "Lags 1-10" = 1:10,
  "Lags 1-7"  = 1:7,
  "Lag 7 only" = 7,
  "Lag 10 only" = 10
)

lag_summary_table <- tibble(
  Validation_Model = names(lag_validation_specs),
  Covariate_Lags_Used = sapply(lag_validation_specs, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ", ")),
  StartOfWeek_Lag = "No lag",
  Holiday_Lags = "holiday",
  Case_Lags = "log_cases_lag1 to log_cases_lag10"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Create required lags
# ------------------------------------------------------------

model_data <- model_data %>%
  arrange(Meldedatum) %>%
  mutate(
    public_holiday_lag7 = lag(public_holiday, 7)
  )

# Case lags: always AR(7)
for (l in 1:10) {
  model_data[[paste0("log_cases_lag", l)]] <- lag(model_data$log_cases, l)
}

# Covariates to be lagged
temp_vars <- c("Temp")

age_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^AgeShare_", names(model_data))]
gender_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^GenderShare_", names(model_data))]

lagged_covariates <- c(temp_vars, age_vars, gender_vars)
lagged_covariates <- lagged_covariates[lagged_covariates %in% names(model_data)]

# Create lags 1-10 for temp, age shares, and gender shares
for (v in lagged_covariates) {
  for (l in 1:10) {
    model_data[[paste0(v, "_lag", l)]] <- lag(model_data[[v]], l)
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Train-validation split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linear_validation_data <- model_data %>%
  drop_na(log_cases, cases)

split_id <- floor(0.8 * nrow(linear_validation_data))

linear_train <- linear_validation_data[1:split_id, ]
linear_valid <- linear_validation_data[(split_id + 1):nrow(linear_validation_data), ]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Function to run linear ARX validation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_linear_arx_validation <- function(lag_set_name, cov_lags) {
  
  case_lags <- paste0("log_cases_lag", 1:10)
  
  cov_lag_vars <- unlist(
    lapply(lagged_covariates, function(v) {
      paste0(v, "_lag", cov_lags)
    })
  )
  
  cov_lag_vars <- cov_lag_vars[cov_lag_vars %in% names(model_data)]
  
  fixed_covariates <- c(
    "StartOfWeek",
    "public_holiday",
    "public_holiday_lag7"
  )
  
  fixed_covariates <- fixed_covariates[fixed_covariates %in% names(model_data)]
  
  x_vars <- c(case_lags, cov_lag_vars, fixed_covariates)
  x_vars <- x_vars[x_vars %in% names(model_data)]
  
  train_df <- linear_train %>%
    select(Meldedatum, cases, log_cases, all_of(x_vars)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  valid_df <- linear_valid %>%
    select(Meldedatum, cases, log_cases, all_of(x_vars)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  formula_model <- as.formula(
    paste("log_cases ~", paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )
  
  fit <- lm(formula_model, data = train_df)
  
  pred_log <- predict(fit, newdata = valid_df)
  pred_cases <- expm1(pred_log)
  
  valid_df %>%
    mutate(
      Method = "OLS",
      Forecast_type = "Validation",
      Model = paste0("Linear ARX: ", lag_set_name),
      Forecast_log = as.numeric(pred_log),
      Forecast_cases = as.numeric(pred_cases),
      Actual_log = log_cases,
      Actual_cases = cases,
      Error_log = Actual_log - Forecast_log,
      Error_cases = Actual_cases - Forecast_cases
    )
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run all four lag validation models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linear_arx_validation_forecasts <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(lag_validation_specs), function(spec_name) {
    run_linear_arx_validation(
      lag_set_name = spec_name,
      cov_lags = lag_validation_specs[[spec_name]]
    )
  })
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validation accuracy table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

linear_arx_validation_accuracy <- linear_arx_validation_forecasts %>%
  group_by(Method, Forecast_type, Model) %>%
  summarise(
    MSFE_cases = mean(Error_cases^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSFE_cases = sqrt(MSFE_cases),
    MSFE_log = mean(Error_log^2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSFE_log = sqrt(MSFE_log),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(RMSFE_cases)

knitr::kable(
  linear_arx_validation_accuracy,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Validation results for linear ARX models with alternative covariate lag structures"
)

```


# Train-test split

```{r train-test-split}
n <- nrow(model_data)
test_start <- floor(0.80 * n) + 1

initial_train_data <- model_data[1:(test_start - 1), ]
test_data <- model_data[test_start:n, ]

rolling_window_size <- nrow(initial_train_data)

cat("Initial training rows:", nrow(initial_train_data), "\n")
cat("Test rows:", nrow(test_data), "\n")
cat("Rolling window size:", rolling_window_size, "\n")
cat("Test period:", as.character(min(test_data$Meldedatum)), "to", as.character(max(test_data$Meldedatum)), "\n")

sample_split_table <- tibble(
  Sample = c("Initial training", "Test"),
  Rows = c(nrow(initial_train_data), nrow(test_data)),
  Start = c(min(initial_train_data$Meldedatum), min(test_data$Meldedatum)),
  End = c(max(initial_train_data$Meldedatum), max(test_data$Meldedatum))
)

knitr::kable(sample_split_table, caption = "Sample split")
```

# Predictor groups

```{r predictor-groups}
case_lags_7 <- paste0("lag", 1:10)

age_lag7_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^AgeShare_.*_lag7$", names(model_data))]
gender_lag7_vars <- names(model_data)[grepl("^GenderShare_.*_lag7$", names(model_data))]

temp_vars <- c("Temp_lag7")
start_week_vars <- c("StartOfWeek_lag7")
holiday_vars <- c("public_holiday_lag7","public_holiday")
delay_vars <- c("reporting_delay_avg_lag7")
symptom_vars <- c("symptom_onset_share_lag7")

temp_vars <- temp_vars[temp_vars %in% names(model_data)]
start_week_vars <- start_week_vars[start_week_vars %in% names(model_data)]
holiday_vars <- holiday_vars[holiday_vars %in% names(model_data)]
delay_vars <- delay_vars[delay_vars %in% names(model_data)]
symptom_vars <- symptom_vars[symptom_vars %in% names(model_data)]

calendar_vars <- c(start_week_vars, holiday_vars)
demo_vars <- c(age_lag7_vars, gender_lag7_vars)
delay_onset_vars <- c(delay_vars, symptom_vars)

all_covariates <- c(
  temp_vars,
  calendar_vars,
  demo_vars,
  delay_onset_vars
)
```

# Aligned model specifications

Every method receives the same model specifications and the same lag structure.

```{r model-specifications}
model_specs <- list(
  list(
    name = "Lagged cases only",
    predictors = case_lags_7
  ),
  list(
    name = "Lagged cases + Temp + Age + Gender + StartOfWeek + Holiday",
    predictors = c(case_lags_7, temp_vars, demo_vars, calendar_vars)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Lagged cases + StartOfWeek + Holiday + Delay + Symptom onset",
    predictors = c(case_lags_7, calendar_vars, delay_onset_vars)
  ),
  list(
    name = "Lagged cases + All covariates",
    predictors = c(case_lags_7, all_covariates)
  )
)

# Keep only predictors that exist
model_specs <- lapply(model_specs, function(spec) {
  spec$predictors <- unique(spec$predictors[spec$predictors %in% names(model_data)])
  spec
})

model_spec_table <- bind_rows(lapply(model_specs, function(spec) {
  tibble(
    Model = spec$name,
    Number_of_predictors = length(spec$predictors),
    Predictors = paste(spec$predictors, collapse = " + ")
  )
}))

```

# Time-series diagnostics and AR lag-order selection

The following diagnostics are produced after construction of the modelling data. The AR order is selected for `log_cases` over candidate orders 0 through 10 using both AIC and BIC on the initial training sample. The BIC-selected order is used as the preferred parsimonious AR order; the AIC-selected order is also reported.

```{r log-cases-diagnostics-ar-order, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Time-series plot of observed cases
p_cases_ts <- ggplot(model_data, aes(x = Meldedatum, y = cases)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Daily reported COVID-19 cases",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_cases_ts)

# ACF and PACF of log cases using the training sample only
acf(initial_train_data$log_cases,
    lag.max = 40,
    na.action = na.pass,
    main = "ACF of log(cases + 1): initial training sample")

pacf(initial_train_data$log_cases,
     lag.max = 40,
     na.action = na.pass,
     main = "PACF of log(cases + 1): initial training sample")

# Fit AR(p) models for p = 0, ..., 10 and compare AIC/BIC.
# AR(0) is an intercept-only benchmark.
ar_order_results <- purrr::map_dfr(0:max_ar_p, function(p_order) {
  if (p_order == 0) {
    fit <- lm(log_cases ~ 1, data = initial_train_data)
  } else {
    lag_names <- paste0("lag", seq_len(p_order))
    lag_names <- lag_names[lag_names %in% names(initial_train_data)]

    if (length(lag_names) != p_order) {
      return(tibble(
        p = p_order,
        AIC = NA_real_,
        BIC = NA_real_,
        N = NA_integer_
      ))
    }

    fit <- lm(stats::reformulate(lag_names, response = "log_cases"), data = initial_train_data)
  }

  tibble(
    p = p_order,
    AIC = AIC(fit),
    BIC = BIC(fit),
    N = stats::nobs(fit)
  )
})

best_p_aic <- ar_order_results %>%
  filter(is.finite(AIC)) %>%
  slice_min(AIC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(p)

best_p_bic <- ar_order_results %>%
  filter(is.finite(BIC)) %>%
  slice_min(BIC, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(p)

selected_ar_p <- best_p_bic
selected_ar_lags <- paste0("lag", seq_len(selected_ar_p))
selected_ar_lags <- selected_ar_lags[selected_ar_lags %in% names(model_data)]

knitr::kable(
  ar_order_results,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "AR lag-order selection for log(cases + 1), maximum lag 10"
)

cat("AIC-selected AR order:", best_p_aic, "\n")
cat("BIC-selected AR order:", best_p_bic, "\n")
cat("Preferred parsimonious order used for reporting:", selected_ar_p, "\n")

# Plot AIC and BIC across candidate AR orders
ar_ic_long <- ar_order_results %>%
  select(p, AIC, BIC) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(AIC, BIC), names_to = "Criterion", values_to = "Value")

p_ar_ic <- ggplot(ar_ic_long, aes(x = p, y = Value, linetype = Criterion)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:max_ar_p) +
  labs(
    title = "AIC and BIC for AR(p) models of log cases",
    subtitle = paste0("AIC selects p = ", best_p_aic,
                      "; BIC selects p = ", best_p_bic),
    x = "AR order p",
    y = "Information criterion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_ar_ic)
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
make_formula <- function(x_vars) {
  as.formula(
    paste("log_cases ~", paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )
}

rmsfe <- function(actual, forecast) {
  sqrt(mean((actual - forecast)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
}

make_forecast_table <- function(test_rows, model_name, method_name, forecast_type, forecast_log) {
  forecast_cases <- pmax(exp(forecast_log) - 1, 0)

  test_rows %>%
    select(Meldedatum, cases, log_cases) %>%
    mutate(
      Model = model_name,
      Method = method_name,
      Forecast_type = forecast_type,
      Forecast_log = as.numeric(forecast_log),
      Forecast_cases = as.numeric(forecast_cases),
      Error_log = log_cases - Forecast_log,
      Error_cases = cases - Forecast_cases
    )
}

calculate_accuracy <- function(forecast_df) {
  forecast_df %>%
    group_by(Method, Forecast_type, Model) %>%
    summarise(
      MSFE_log = mean(Error_log^2, na.rm = TRUE),
      RMSFE_log = sqrt(mean(Error_log^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      MSFE_cases = mean(Error_cases^2, na.rm = TRUE),
      RMSFE_cases = sqrt(mean(Error_cases^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(RMSFE_cases)
}
```

## Fixed test forecasts

```{r ols-fixed-forecasts}
# Combine model specification sets
all_model_specs <- c(
  lapply(model_specs, function(spec) {
    spec$spec_set <- "Model specs 1"
    spec
  }),
  lapply(model_specs_2, function(spec) {
    spec$spec_set <- "Model specs 2"
    spec
  })
)

fixed_ols_forecasts <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(all_model_specs)
)

for (i in seq_along(all_model_specs)) {
  spec <- all_model_specs[[i]]

  formula_model <- make_formula(spec$predictors)

  # Fit fixed OLS model using the initial training sample
  linear_model <- lm(
    formula = formula_model,
    data = initial_train_data
  )

  # Generate predictions for the fixed test sample
  linear_forecast_log <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      linear_model,
      newdata = test_data
    )
  )

  fixed_ols_forecasts[[i]] <- make_forecast_table(
    test_rows = test_data,
    model_name = spec$name,
    method_name = "Linear model",
    forecast_type = "Fixed test",
    forecast_log = linear_forecast_log
  ) |>
    mutate(
      Model_spec_set = spec$spec_set
    )
}

fixed_ols_forecasts <- bind_rows(fixed_ols_forecasts)

fixed_ols_accuracy <- calculate_accuracy(
  fixed_ols_forecasts
)

knitr::kable(
  fixed_ols_accuracy,
  digits = 3,
  caption = paste(
    "Fixed test accuracy: Linear models using",
    "model specifications 1 and 2"
  )
)
```

## Rolling-window forecasts

```{r ols-rolling-forecasts}

rolling_ols_forecasts <- list()
counter <- 1

test_indices <- test_start:nrow(model_data)

for (i in seq_along(all_model_specs)) {
  spec <- all_model_specs[[i]]
  formula_model <- make_formula(spec$predictors)
  
  for (method_name in c("Linear model")) {
    
    model_forecasts <- list()
    
    for (j in seq_along(test_indices)) {
      test_i <- test_indices[j]
      train_start_i <- test_i - rolling_window_size
      train_end_i <- test_i - 1
      
      train_window <- model_data[train_start_i:train_end_i, ]
      test_row <- model_data[test_i, ]
      
      model_fit <- lm(formula_model, data = train_window)
      forecast_log <- as.numeric(predict(model_fit, newdata = test_row))
      
      model_forecasts[[j]] <- make_forecast_table(
        test_rows = test_row,
        model_name = spec$name,
        method_name = method_name,
        forecast_type = "Rolling window",
        forecast_log = forecast_log
      )
    }
    
    rolling_ols_forecasts[[counter]] <- bind_rows(model_forecasts)
    counter <- counter + 1
  }
}

rolling_ols_forecasts <- bind_rows(rolling_ols_forecasts)
rolling_ols_accuracy <- calculate_accuracy(rolling_ols_forecasts)

knitr::kable(rolling_ols_accuracy, digits = 3, caption = "Rolling-window accuracy:  Linear models")
```

# Machine learning models



```{r ml-validation-split}
n_initial <- nrow(initial_train_data)
validation_start <- floor(0.80 * n_initial) + 1

cv_train <- initial_train_data[1:(validation_start - 1), ]
cv_valid <- initial_train_data[validation_start:n_initial, ]

cat("ML tuning training rows:", nrow(cv_train), "\n")
cat("ML tuning validation rows:", nrow(cv_valid), "\n")
```

## Hyperparameter grids

```{r ml-grids}
tree_grid <- expand.grid(
  minsplit = c(10, 20, 30, 50),
  maxdepth = c(3, 5, 7, 10),
  cp = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rf_trees <- c(100, 200, 300)
```

## Tuning functions

```{r ml-tuning-functions}
tune_tree <- function(predictors, cv_train, cv_valid) {
  formula_model <- make_formula(predictors)
  out <- list()

  for (i in 1:nrow(tree_grid)) {
    fit <- rpart::rpart(
      formula_model,
      data = cv_train,
      method = "anova",
      control = rpart::rpart.control(
        minsplit = tree_grid$minsplit[i],
        maxdepth = tree_grid$maxdepth[i],
        cp = tree_grid$cp[i]
      )
    )

    pred <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = cv_valid))

    out[[i]] <- data.frame(
      minsplit = tree_grid$minsplit[i],
      maxdepth = tree_grid$maxdepth[i],
      cp = tree_grid$cp[i],
      Validation_RMSFE_log = rmsfe(cv_valid$log_cases, pred)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out) %>%
    arrange(Validation_RMSFE_log) %>%
    slice(1)
}

tune_rf <- function(predictors, cv_train, cv_valid) {
  p <- length(predictors)

  if (p <= 10) {
    mtry_values <- c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
  } else {
    mtry_values <- unique(c(5, 10, 20, 30, 50, floor(sqrt(p)), floor(p / 3)))
  }

  mtry_values <- unique(pmin(p, pmax(1, mtry_values)))

  rf_grid <- expand.grid(
    mtry = mtry_values,
    min.node.size = c(1, 5, 10, 20),
    num.trees = rf_trees,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  formula_model <- make_formula(predictors)
  out <- list()

  for (i in 1:nrow(rf_grid)) {
    fit <- ranger::ranger(
      formula_model,
      data = cv_train,
      num.trees = rf_grid$num.trees[i],
      mtry = rf_grid$mtry[i],
      min.node.size = rf_grid$min.node.size[i],
      seed = 123
    )

    pred <- predict(fit, data = cv_valid)$predictions

    out[[i]] <- data.frame(
      mtry = rf_grid$mtry[i],
      min.node.size = rf_grid$min.node.size[i],
      num.trees = rf_grid$num.trees[i],
      Validation_RMSFE_log = rmsfe(cv_valid$log_cases, pred)
    )
  }

  bind_rows(out) %>%
    arrange(Validation_RMSFE_log) %>%
    slice(1)
}
```

## ML hyperparameter tuning only

Fixed train-test forecasts for the machine-learning models are intentionally removed.
The validation block below only selects hyperparameters for the rolling-window and expanding-window ML forecasts.

```{r ml-hyperparameter-selection}
tree_best_list <- list()
rf_best_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(model_specs)) {
  spec <- model_specs[[i]]

  best_tree <- tune_tree(spec$predictors, cv_train, cv_valid)
  tree_best_list[[i]] <- best_tree %>%
    mutate(Model = spec$name, Method = "Regression Tree")

  best_rf <- tune_rf(spec$predictors, cv_train, cv_valid)
  rf_best_list[[i]] <- best_rf %>%
    mutate(Model = spec$name, Method = "Random Forest")
}

tree_best_table <- bind_rows(tree_best_list)
rf_best_table <- bind_rows(rf_best_list)

)

)
```

```{r ml-rolling-forecasts}
      test_rows = test_row,
      model_name = spec$name,
      method_name = "Random Forest",
      forecast_type = "Rolling window",
      forecast_log = forecast_log
    )
  }

  rolling_ml_forecasts[[counter]] <- bind_rows(rf_rows)
  counter <- counter + 1
}
```

# SARX models

The SARX part uses the same aligned model specifications, but adds an annual seasonal autoregressive term and the seasonal cross-lags.
Fixed test SARX forecasts are intentionally removed. Only rolling-window and expanding-window SARX forecasts are estimated and then added to the combined forecast table.

```{r sarx-seasonal-lags}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Seasonal AR terms for SARX
# SARX(p) uses lag1...lagp, lag365, and lag365+1...lag365+p.
# These are created on the full ordered model_data so that the test rows
# keep valid annual lag information.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
seasonal_period <- 365
sarx_p <- 10

model_data$lag365 <- dplyr::lag(model_data$log_cases, seasonal_period)

for (l in 1:sarx_p) {
  model_data[[paste0("lag", seasonal_period + l)]] <-
    dplyr::lag(model_data$log_cases, seasonal_period + l)
}

# Refresh the existing train-test objects after adding SARX variables.
initial_train_data <- model_data[1:(test_start - 1), ]
test_data <- model_data[test_start:nrow(model_data), ]
test_indices <- test_start:nrow(model_data)

sarx_base_vars <- c(
  paste0("lag", 1:sarx_p),
  "lag365",
  paste0("lag", seasonal_period + 1:sarx_p)
)

sarx_base_vars <- sarx_base_vars[sarx_base_vars %in% names(model_data)]

sarx_specs <- lapply(model_specs, function(spec) {
  list(
    name = spec$name,
    predictors = unique(c(sarx_base_vars, setdiff(spec$predictors, paste0("lag", 1:10))))
  )
})

sarx_specs <- lapply(sarx_specs, function(spec) {
  spec$predictors <- unique(spec$predictors[spec$predictors %in% names(model_data)])
  spec
})

sarx_spec_table <- bind_rows(lapply(sarx_specs, function(spec) {
  tibble(
    Model = spec$name,
    Number_of_predictors = length(spec$predictors),
    Predictors = paste(spec$predictors, collapse = " + ")
  )
}))

```

```{r sarx-rolling-forecasts}
rolling_sarx_forecasts <- list()

for (m in seq_along(sarx_specs)) {
  spec <- sarx_specs[[m]]
  formula_model <- make_formula(spec$predictors)
  forecast_rows <- list()

  for (j in seq_along(test_indices)) {
    test_i <- test_indices[j]
    train_start_i <- test_i - rolling_window_size
    train_end_i <- test_i - 1

    train_window <- model_data[train_start_i:train_end_i, ]
    test_row <- model_data[test_i, ]

    sarx_fit <- lm(formula_model, data = train_window, na.action = na.exclude)
    forecast_log <- as.numeric(predict(sarx_fit, newdata = test_row))

    forecast_rows[[j]] <- make_forecast_table(
      test_rows = test_row,
      model_name = spec$name,
      method_name = "SARX",
      forecast_type = "Rolling window",
      forecast_log = forecast_log
    )
  }

  rolling_sarx_forecasts[[m]] <- bind_rows(forecast_rows)
}

rolling_sarx_forecasts <- bind_rows(rolling_sarx_forecasts)
rolling_sarx_accuracy <- calculate_accuracy(rolling_sarx_forecasts)

knitr::kable(
  rolling_sarx_accuracy,
  digits = 3,
  caption = "Rolling-window SARX forecast accuracy"
)
```

# Individual actual-vs-forecast plots

This chunk creates one separate actual-vs-forecast plot for every available combination of method, forecast type, and model. The plots are saved as PNG files and also printed individually in the knitted report.

```{r individual-actual-vs-forecast-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
plot_dir <- "project3_individual_actual_vs_forecast_plots"
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

safe_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_+", "_") %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("^_|_$", "")
}

make_actual_forecast_plot <- function(df_one, title_text) {
  ggplot(df_one, aes(x = Meldedatum)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cases), linewidth = 0.45) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Forecast_cases), linewidth = 0.45, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = "Solid line = actual cases; dashed line = forecast cases",
      x = "Date",
      y = "Daily cases"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

# 1. Create forecast-loss variables and exclude SARX

SARX models are removed before any loss summary, DM test, tournament, or MCS comparison.

```{r create-forecast-losses, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
all_model_losses <- all_forecasts_combined %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("SARX", Method, ignore.case = TRUE),
    !grepl("SARX", Model, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Absolute_Error_log = abs(Error_log),
    Squared_Error_log = Error_log^2,
    Absolute_Error_cases = abs(Error_cases),
    Squared_Error_cases = Error_cases^2
  )
```

```{r summarize-model-losses, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  group_by(Method, Forecast_type, Model) %>%

    N = sum(is.finite(Error_cases)),
    MAE_cases = mean(Absolute_Error_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    MSFE_cases = mean(Squared_Error_cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    RMSFE_cases = sqrt(MSFE_cases),
    MAE_log = mean(Absolute_Error_log, na.rm = TRUE),
    MSFE_log = mean(Squared_Error_log, na.rm = TRUE),

)
```

# 3. Manual Diebold-Mariano test function

```{r manual-dm-function, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
manual_dm_test <- function(loss_difference, h = 1) {
  loss_difference <- loss_difference[is.finite(loss_difference)]
  n_obs <- length(loss_difference)

  if (
    n_obs < 5 ||
    !is.finite(stats::sd(loss_difference)) ||
    stats::sd(loss_difference) == 0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble(
        DM_stat = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_loss_difference = mean(loss_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
        long_run_variance = NA_real_,
        T = n_obs
      )
    )
  }

  centered_difference <- loss_difference - mean(loss_difference)
  gamma_0 <- sum(centered_difference^2) / n_obs
  long_run_variance <- gamma_0

  if (h > 1) {
    for (lag_i in seq_len(h - 1)) {
      gamma_i <- sum(
        centered_difference[(lag_i + 1):n_obs] *
          centered_difference[1:(n_obs - lag_i)]
      ) / n_obs

      bartlett_weight <- 1 - lag_i / h
      long_run_variance <- long_run_variance +
        2 * bartlett_weight * gamma_i
    }
  }

  if (!is.finite(long_run_variance) || long_run_variance <= 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        DM_stat = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_loss_difference = mean(loss_difference),
        long_run_variance = long_run_variance,
        T = n_obs
      )
    )
  }

  dm_statistic <- mean(loss_difference) /
    sqrt(long_run_variance / n_obs)

  p_value <- 2 * (1 - stats::pnorm(abs(dm_statistic)))

  tibble(
    DM_stat = dm_statistic,
    p_value = p_value,
    mean_loss_difference = mean(loss_difference),
    long_run_variance = long_run_variance,
    T = n_obs
  )
}
```

# 4. Pairwise DM-test function

```{r pairwise-dm-function, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pairwise_dm_tests <- function(
  loss_data,
  comparison_keys,
  loss_col,
  h = 1,
  alpha = 0.05
) {
  output <- list()
  result_counter <- 1

  forecast_types <- unique(comparison_keys$Forecast_type)

  for (forecast_type_i in forecast_types) {
    keys_for_type <- comparison_keys %>%
      filter(Forecast_type == forecast_type_i)

    if (nrow(keys_for_type) < 2) next

    for (i in seq_len(nrow(keys_for_type) - 1)) {
      for (j in (i + 1):nrow(keys_for_type)) {
        model_1 <- keys_for_type[i, ]
        model_2 <- keys_for_type[j, ]

        model_1_losses <- loss_data %>%
          filter(
            Forecast_type == model_1$Forecast_type,
            Method == model_1$Method,
            Model == model_1$Model
          ) %>%
          select(Meldedatum, loss_1 = all_of(loss_col))

        model_2_losses <- loss_data %>%
          filter(
            Forecast_type == model_2$Forecast_type,
            Method == model_2$Method,
            Model == model_2$Model
          ) %>%
          select(Meldedatum, loss_2 = all_of(loss_col))

        joined_losses <- inner_join(
          model_1_losses,
          model_2_losses,
          by = "Meldedatum"
        ) %>%
          filter(is.finite(loss_1), is.finite(loss_2)) %>%
          mutate(loss_difference = loss_1 - loss_2)

        dm_result <- manual_dm_test(
          joined_losses$loss_difference,
          h = h
        ) %>%
          mutate(
            Forecast_type = forecast_type_i,
            Loss_function = loss_col,
            Model_1 = paste(model_1$Method, model_1$Model, sep = " | "),
            Model_2 = paste(model_2$Method, model_2$Model, sep = " | "),
            Interpretation = case_when(
              is.na(p_value) ~ "DM test unavailable",
              p_value < alpha & mean_loss_difference < 0 ~
                "Model 1 has significantly lower loss",
              p_value < alpha & mean_loss_difference > 0 ~
                "Model 2 has significantly lower loss",
              TRUE ~ "No significant difference"
            )
          )

        output[[result_counter]] <- dm_result
        result_counter <- result_counter + 1
      }
    }
  }

  bind_rows(output) %>%
    arrange(Forecast_type, p_value) %>%
    select(
      Forecast_type,
      Loss_function,
      Model_1,
      Model_2,
      T,
      mean_loss_difference,
      long_run_variance,
      DM_stat,
      p_value,
      Interpretation
    )
}
```

# 6. Helper functions for model identifiers

```{r model-id-helper-functions, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
create_model_id <- function(method, model) {
  paste(method, model, sep = " | ")
}

split_model_id <- function(model_id) {
  model_parts <- strsplit(
    model_id,
    " | ",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  list(
    Method = model_parts[1],
    Model = paste(model_parts[-1], collapse = " | ")
  )
}
```

# 7. DM tournament function

```{r dm-tournament-function, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
run_dm_tournament <- function(
  loss_data,
  forecast_type,
  loss_col = "Squared_Error_cases",
  h = 1,
  alpha = 0.05
) {
  candidates <- loss_data %>%
    filter(Forecast_type == forecast_type) %>%
    distinct(Method, Model) %>%
    arrange(Method, Model) %>%
    mutate(Model_ID = create_model_id(Method, Model)) %>%
    pull(Model_ID)

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    return(list(rounds = tibble(), champion = tibble()))
  }

  all_rounds <- list()
  round_number <- 1

  while (length(candidates) > 1) {
    candidate_order <- loss_data %>%
      filter(Forecast_type == forecast_type) %>%
      mutate(Model_ID = create_model_id(Method, Model)) %>%
      filter(Model_ID %in% candidates) %>%
      group_by(Model_ID) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean_loss = mean(.data[[loss_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(Mean_loss) %>%
      pull(Model_ID)

    candidates <- candidate_order
    round_results <- list()
    winners <- character()
    pair_number <- 1
    pair_starts <- seq(1, length(candidates), by = 2)

    for (start_i in pair_starts) {
      model_1_id <- candidates[start_i]

      if (start_i == length(candidates)) {
        winners <- c(winners, model_1_id)

        round_results[[pair_number]] <- tibble(
          Forecast_type = forecast_type,
          Loss_function = loss_col,
          Round = round_number,
          Pair = pair_number,
          Model_1 = model_1_id,
          Model_2 = NA_character_,
          T = NA_integer_,
          Mean_loss_1 = NA_real_,
          Mean_loss_2 = NA_real_,
          mean_loss_difference = NA_real_,
          DM_stat = NA_real_,
          p_value = NA_real_,
          Winner = model_1_id,
          Decision = "Bye to next round"
        )

        pair_number <- pair_number + 1
        next
      }

      model_2_id <- candidates[start_i + 1]
      model_1_parts <- split_model_id(model_1_id)
      model_2_parts <- split_model_id(model_2_id)

      model_1_losses <- loss_data %>%
        filter(
          Forecast_type == forecast_type,
          Method == model_1_parts$Method,
          Model == model_1_parts$Model
        ) %>%
        select(Meldedatum, loss_1 = all_of(loss_col))

      model_2_losses <- loss_data %>%
        filter(
          Forecast_type == forecast_type,
          Method == model_2_parts$Method,
          Model == model_2_parts$Model
        ) %>%
        select(Meldedatum, loss_2 = all_of(loss_col))

      paired_losses <- inner_join(
        model_1_losses,
        model_2_losses,
        by = "Meldedatum"
      ) %>%
        filter(is.finite(loss_1), is.finite(loss_2)) %>%
        mutate(loss_difference = loss_1 - loss_2)

      dm_result <- manual_dm_test(
        paired_losses$loss_difference,
        h = h
      )

      mean_loss_1 <- mean(paired_losses$loss_1, na.rm = TRUE)
      mean_loss_2 <- mean(paired_losses$loss_2, na.rm = TRUE)

      winner <- if (mean_loss_1 <= mean_loss_2) {
        model_1_id
      } else {
        model_2_id
      }

      decision <- case_when(
        is.na(dm_result$p_value) ~
          "DM unavailable; lower mean loss advances",
        dm_result$p_value < alpha & dm_result$mean_loss_difference < 0 ~
          "Model 1 significantly better",
        dm_result$p_value < alpha & dm_result$mean_loss_difference > 0 ~
          "Model 2 significantly better",
        TRUE ~
          "No significant difference; lower mean loss advances"
      )

      winners <- c(winners, winner)

      round_results[[pair_number]] <- tibble(
        Forecast_type = forecast_type,
        Loss_function = loss_col,
        Round = round_number,
        Pair = pair_number,
        Model_1 = model_1_id,
        Model_2 = model_2_id,
        T = dm_result$T,
        Mean_loss_1 = mean_loss_1,
        Mean_loss_2 = mean_loss_2,
        mean_loss_difference = dm_result$mean_loss_difference,
        DM_stat = dm_result$DM_stat,
        p_value = dm_result$p_value,
        Winner = winner,
        Decision = decision
      )

      pair_number <- pair_number + 1
    }

    all_rounds[[round_number]] <- bind_rows(round_results)
    candidates <- unique(winners)
    round_number <- round_number + 1
  }

  champion_id <- candidates[1]
  champion_parts <- split_model_id(champion_id)

  champion <- loss_data %>%
    filter(
      Forecast_type == forecast_type,
      Method == champion_parts$Method,
      Model == champion_parts$Model
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      Forecast_type = forecast_type,
      Loss_function = loss_col,
      Champion = champion_id,
      Mean_loss = mean(.data[[loss_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      RMSFE_cases = sqrt(mean(Squared_Error_cases, na.rm = TRUE)),
      N = sum(is.finite(.data[[loss_col]]))
    )

  list(
    rounds = bind_rows(all_rounds),
    champion = champion
  )
}
```

```{r expanding-window-dm-tournament, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  expanding_dm_best_model,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Final expanding-window model selected by the DM tournament"
)
```

# 10. Combine rolling and expanding winners

```{r combine-dm-winners, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
best_dm_models <- bind_rows(
  rolling_dm_best_model,
  expanding_dm_best_model
)

knitr::kable(
  best_dm_models,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Final models selected for rolling and expanding windows"
)
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Manual Diebold-Mariano test
# ------------------------------------------------------------

manual_dm_test <- function(loss_difference, h = 1) {

  loss_difference <- as.numeric(loss_difference)
  loss_difference <- loss_difference[is.finite(loss_difference)]

  n_obs <- length(loss_difference)

  if (n_obs < 5) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        DM_stat = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_loss_difference = ifelse(
          n_obs > 0,
          mean(loss_difference),
          NA_real_
        ),
        long_run_variance = NA_real_,
        T = n_obs
      )
    )
  }

  loss_sd <- stats::sd(loss_difference)

  if (!is.finite(loss_sd) || loss_sd <= 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        DM_stat = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_loss_difference = mean(loss_difference),
        long_run_variance = NA_real_,
        T = n_obs
      )
    )
  }

  mean_difference <- mean(loss_difference)
  centered_difference <- loss_difference - mean_difference

  gamma_0 <- sum(centered_difference^2) / n_obs
  long_run_variance <- gamma_0

  if (h > 1) {
    maximum_lag <- min(h - 1, n_obs - 1)

    for (lag_i in seq_len(maximum_lag)) {

      gamma_i <- sum(
        centered_difference[(lag_i + 1):n_obs] *
          centered_difference[1:(n_obs - lag_i)]
      ) / n_obs

      bartlett_weight <- 1 - lag_i / h

      long_run_variance <- long_run_variance +
        2 * bartlett_weight * gamma_i
    }
  }

  if (
    !is.finite(long_run_variance) ||
    long_run_variance <= 0
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        DM_stat = NA_real_,
        p_value = NA_real_,
        mean_loss_difference = mean_difference,
        long_run_variance = long_run_variance,
        T = n_obs
      )
    )
  }

  dm_statistic <- mean_difference /
    sqrt(long_run_variance / n_obs)

  original_p_value <- 2 * stats::pnorm(
    -abs(dm_statistic)
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    DM_stat = dm_statistic,
    p_value = original_p_value,
    mean_loss_difference = mean_difference,
    long_run_variance = long_run_variance,
    T = n_obs
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Functions for model identifiers
# ------------------------------------------------------------

create_model_id <- function(method, model) {
  paste(method, model, sep = " | ")
}

split_model_id <- function(model_id) {

  model_parts <- strsplit(
    model_id,
    " | ",
    fixed = TRUE
  )[[1]]

  list(
    Method = model_parts[1],
    Model = paste(
      model_parts[-1],
      collapse = " | "
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HLN-corrected DM tournament function
# ------------------------------------------------------------

run_hln_dm_tournament <- function(
  loss_data,
  forecast_type,
  loss_col = "Squared_Error_cases",
  h = 1,
  alpha = 0.05
) {

  # Check required columns
  required_columns <- c(
    "Meldedatum",
    "Method",
    "Forecast_type",
    "Model",
    loss_col
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    names(loss_data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "The following columns are missing:",
        paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  if (!is.numeric(h) || length(h) != 1 || h < 1) {
    stop("h must be a positive number.")
  }

  if (
    !is.numeric(alpha) ||
    length(alpha) != 1 ||
    alpha <= 0 ||
    alpha >= 1
  ) {
    stop("alpha must be between 0 and 1.")
  }

  # Keep the selected forecasting design and valid losses
  tournament_data <- loss_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Forecast_type == forecast_type
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Meldedatum = as.Date(.data$Meldedatum),
      Model_ID = create_model_id(
        .data$Method,
        .data$Model
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.data$Meldedatum),
      is.finite(.data[[loss_col]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(
      .data$Meldedatum,
      .data$Method,
      .data$Model,
      .data$Model_ID
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Loss = mean(
        .data[[loss_col]],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (nrow(tournament_data) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "No valid observations were found for",
        forecast_type
      )
    )
  }

  # Identify candidate models
  candidates <- tournament_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.data$Model_ID) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$Model_ID)

  if (length(candidates) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "No models were found for",
        forecast_type
      )
    )
  }

  # If there is only one model, return it directly
  if (length(candidates) == 1) {

    champion_parts <- split_model_id(candidates[1])

    champion <- tournament_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Model_ID == candidates[1]
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Forecast_type = forecast_type,
        Loss_function = loss_col,
        Method = champion_parts$Method,
        Model = champion_parts$Model,
        Champion = candidates[1],
        Mean_loss = mean(.data$Loss),
        RMSFE_cases = sqrt(mean(.data$Loss)),
        N = dplyr::n()
      )

    return(
      list(
        rounds = tibble::tibble(),
        champion = champion
      )
    )
  }

  all_rounds <- list()
  round_number <- 1

  # Continue until one model remains
  while (length(candidates) > 1) {

    # Rank remaining models by average loss
    candidate_order <- tournament_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        .data$Model_ID %in% candidates
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Model_ID) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Mean_loss = mean(.data$Loss),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(
        .data$Mean_loss,
        .data$Model_ID
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.data$Model_ID)

    candidates <- candidate_order

    round_results <- list()
    winners <- character(0)
    pair_number <- 1

    pair_starts <- seq(
      from = 1,
      to = length(candidates),
      by = 2
    )

    for (start_i in pair_starts) {

      model_1_id <- candidates[start_i]

      # Automatically advance an unmatched model
      if (start_i == length(candidates)) {

        winners <- c(
          winners,
          model_1_id
        )

        round_results[[pair_number]] <-
          tibble::tibble(
            Forecast_type = forecast_type,
            Loss_function = loss_col,
            Round = round_number,
            Pair = pair_number,
            Model_1 = model_1_id,
            Model_2 = NA_character_,
            T = NA_integer_,
            Mean_loss_1 = NA_real_,
            Mean_loss_2 = NA_real_,
            mean_loss_difference = NA_real_,
            DM_stat = NA_real_,
            Original_p_value = NA_real_,
            HLN_factor = NA_real_,
            DM_HLN = NA_real_,
            p_value_HLN = NA_real_,
            Winner = model_1_id,
            Decision = "Automatically advances"
          )

        pair_number <- pair_number + 1
        next
      }

      model_2_id <- candidates[start_i + 1]

      # Obtain losses for Model 1
      model_1_losses <- tournament_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$Model_ID == model_1_id
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Meldedatum,
          loss_1 = .data$Loss
        )

      # Obtain losses for Model 2
      model_2_losses <- tournament_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          .data$Model_ID == model_2_id
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          .data$Meldedatum,
          loss_2 = .data$Loss
        )

      # Compare the models only on common dates
      paired_losses <- dplyr::inner_join(
        model_1_losses,
        model_2_losses,
        by = "Meldedatum"
      ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          is.finite(.data$loss_1),
          is.finite(.data$loss_2)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          loss_difference =
            .data$loss_1 - .data$loss_2
        )

      number_of_common_dates <- nrow(paired_losses)

      # Handle the case with no common observations
      if (number_of_common_dates == 0) {

        overall_mean_loss_1 <- tournament_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$Model_ID == model_1_id
          ) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            value = mean(.data$Loss)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::pull(.data$value)

        overall_mean_loss_2 <- tournament_data %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .data$Model_ID == model_2_id
          ) %>%
          dplyr::summarise(
            value = mean(.data$Loss)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::pull(.data$value)

        winner <- if (
          overall_mean_loss_1 <= overall_mean_loss_2
        ) {
          model_1_id
        } else {
          model_2_id
        }

        winners <- c(winners, winner)

        round_results[[pair_number]] <-
          tibble::tibble(
            Forecast_type = forecast_type,
            Loss_function = loss_col,
            Round = round_number,
            Pair = pair_number,
            Model_1 = model_1_id,
            Model_2 = model_2_id,
            T = 0L,
            Mean_loss_1 = overall_mean_loss_1,
            Mean_loss_2 = overall_mean_loss_2,
            mean_loss_difference =
              overall_mean_loss_1 -
              overall_mean_loss_2,
            DM_stat = NA_real_,
            Original_p_value = NA_real_,
            HLN_factor = NA_real_,
            DM_HLN = NA_real_,
            p_value_HLN = NA_real_,
            Winner = winner,
            Decision = paste(
              "No common forecast dates;",
              "lower overall mean loss advances"
            )
          )

        pair_number <- pair_number + 1
        next
      }

      mean_loss_1 <- mean(
        paired_losses$loss_1
      )

      mean_loss_2 <- mean(
        paired_losses$loss_2
      )

      mean_loss_difference <-
        mean_loss_1 - mean_loss_2

      # Run the original DM test
      dm_result <- manual_dm_test(
        loss_difference =
          paired_losses$loss_difference,
        h = h
      )

      T_value <- as.integer(dm_result$T[1])
      original_dm <- as.numeric(
        dm_result$DM_stat[1]
      )
      original_p_value <- as.numeric(
        dm_result$p_value[1]
      )

      # Default corrected values
      HLN_factor <- NA_real_
      DM_HLN <- NA_real_
      p_value_HLN <- NA_real_

      # Apply the HLN correction when possible
      correction_numerator <-
        T_value +
        1 -
        2 * h +
        (h * (h - 1)) / T_value

      if (
        is.finite(original_dm) &&
        T_value > 1 &&
        is.finite(correction_numerator) &&
        correction_numerator > 0
      ) {

        HLN_factor <- sqrt(
          correction_numerator / T_value
        )

        DM_HLN <- original_dm * HLN_factor

        p_value_HLN <- 2 * stats::pt(
          -abs(DM_HLN),
          df = T_value - 1
        )
      }

      # The lower mean loss determines the model that advances
      lower_loss_model <- if (
        mean_loss_1 <= mean_loss_2
      ) {
        model_1_id
      } else {
        model_2_id
      }

      # Use the corrected p-value for the statistical decision
      if (!is.finite(p_value_HLN)) {

        winner <- lower_loss_model

        decision <- paste(
          "HLN-corrected DM test unavailable;",
          "lower mean loss advances"
        )

      } else if (
        p_value_HLN < alpha &&
        mean_loss_difference < 0
      ) {

        winner <- model_1_id
        decision <- "Model 1 is significantly better"

      } else if (
        p_value_HLN < alpha &&
        mean_loss_difference > 0
      ) {

        winner <- model_2_id
        decision <- "Model 2 is significantly better"

      } else {

        winner <- lower_loss_model

        decision <- paste(
          "No significant difference;",
          "lower mean loss advances"
        )
      }

      winners <- c(
        winners,
        winner
      )

      round_results[[pair_number]] <-
        tibble::tibble(
          Forecast_type = forecast_type,
          Loss_function = loss_col,
          Round = round_number,
          Pair = pair_number,
          Model_1 = model_1_id,
          Model_2 = model_2_id,
          T = T_value,
          Mean_loss_1 = mean_loss_1,
          Mean_loss_2 = mean_loss_2,
          mean_loss_difference =
            mean_loss_difference,
          DM_stat = original_dm,
          Original_p_value =
            original_p_value,
          HLN_factor = HLN_factor,
          DM_HLN = DM_HLN,
          p_value_HLN = p_value_HLN,
          Winner = winner,
          Decision = decision
        )

      pair_number <- pair_number + 1
    }

    all_rounds[[round_number]] <-
      dplyr::bind_rows(round_results)

    candidates <- unique(winners)
    round_number <- round_number + 1
  }

  # Extract final champion
  champion_id <- candidates[1]
  champion_parts <- split_model_id(champion_id)

  champion <- tournament_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$Model_ID == champion_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Forecast_type = forecast_type,
      Loss_function = loss_col,
      Method = champion_parts$Method,
      Model = champion_parts$Model,
      Champion = champion_id,
      Mean_loss = mean(.data$Loss),
      RMSFE_cases = sqrt(mean(.data$Loss)),
      N = dplyr::n()
    )

  list(
    rounds = dplyr::bind_rows(all_rounds),
    champion = champion
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Run the rolling-window tournament
# ------------------------------------------------------------

rolling_hln_dm_tournament <- run_hln_dm_tournament(
  loss_data = all_model_losses,
  forecast_type = "Rolling window",
  loss_col = "Squared_Error_cases",
  h = 1,
  alpha = 0.05
)

rolling_dm_rounds_hln <-
  rolling_hln_dm_tournament$rounds

rolling_dm_best_model_hln <-
  rolling_hln_dm_tournament$champion


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Run the expanding-window tournament
# ------------------------------------------------------------

expanding_hln_dm_tournament <- run_hln_dm_tournament(
  loss_data = all_model_losses,
  forecast_type = "Expanding window",
  loss_col = "Squared_Error_cases",
  h = 1,
  alpha = 0.05
)

expanding_dm_rounds_hln <-
  expanding_hln_dm_tournament$rounds

expanding_dm_best_model_hln <-
  expanding_hln_dm_tournament$champion


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Display rolling-window comparisons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

knitr::kable(
  rolling_dm_rounds_hln %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$Round,
      .data$Pair,
      .data$Model_1,
      .data$Model_2,
      .data$T,
      .data$mean_loss_difference,
      .data$DM_HLN,
      .data$p_value_HLN,
      .data$Winner,
      .data$Decision
    ),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "HLN-corrected Diebold--Mariano tournament:",
    "rolling-window forecasts"
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Display expanding-window comparisons
# ------------------------------------------------------------

knitr::kable(
  expanding_dm_rounds_hln %>%
    dplyr::select(
      .data$Round,
      .data$Pair,
      .data$Model_1,
      .data$Model_2,
      .data$T,
      .data$mean_loss_difference,
      .data$DM_HLN,
      .data$p_value_HLN,
      .data$Winner,
      .data$Decision
    ),
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "HLN-corrected Diebold--Mariano tournament:",
    "expanding-window forecasts"
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Combine and display the selected models
# ------------------------------------------------------------

best_dm_models_hln <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  expanding_dm_best_model_hln,
  rolling_dm_best_model_hln
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data$Forecast_type)

knitr::kable(
  best_dm_models_hln,
  digits = 4,
  caption = paste(
    "Best models selected by the HLN-corrected",
    "Diebold--Mariano tournament"
  )
)
```
